title: Manual and ChatGPT testing-artifact comparison
summary: Postgraduate software-testing students first create use cases, a requirements traceability matrix, test cases, and test scripts for a travel web application in teams. In week nine they regenerate the artifacts individually with ChatGPT, compare both sets, and answer eleven critical-reflection questions.

sources.title: WIP: Assessing the Effectiveness of ChatGPT in Preparatory Testing Activities
sources.evidence_quote: In week 9, after manually completing all these activities, students are given an individual exercise to generate the same artifacts using ChatGPT.

assessment.summary: Generate travel-application testing artifacts manually and with ChatGPT, then compare their quality and usefulness.
student_actions: Create use cases, an RTM, test cases, and scripts manually in a team.
Generate the same artifacts individually with ChatGPT.
Compare both sets and answer eleven reflection questions.

grading.method: Instructors evaluate the testing deliverables and the students' justified comparison findings.
